FINAL NOTICE

Subject: Final notice - balance owing on assessment

Dear client,

An assessment of $12,450.00 CAD on your account remains unpaid. This assessment includes a payroll amount we did not report, which we believe belongs to a subcontractor.

Account: 1199999006-RP0001
Reference: ARC-2026-60231
Deadline: October 22, 2026

You may pay the balance or file a notice of objection before this date. After this date, collection action may follow without further notice.
